create_OnnxController: create an OnnxController instance with an ONNX policy path, default angles, control timestep, and substeps for G1 robot control
run_OnnxController_get_control: run the OnnxController get_control method to apply ONNX policy actions as MuJoCo control signals
run_OnnxController_get_obs: run the OnnxController get_obs method to extract robot observations including linvel, gyro, gravity, joint angles, and joystick commands
run_load_callback: run the load_callback function to initialize a MuJoCo model and data with an ONNX policy controller for G1 simulation
run_viewer_launch: run the MuJoCo viewer with load_callback to launch an interactive G1 robot simulation with joystick control
